title: Admin API: GeneralFaq CRUD
content:
一般 FAQ 條目的管理端 CRUD API，均需 admin role 驗證。

Zod schemas (append to src/lib/validation/faq.ts)：
- generalFaqCreateSchema：categoryId, questionZh, questionEn, questionZhCn?, answerZh, answerEn, answerZhCn?, order?, isPublished?
- generalFaqUpdateSchema：partial() of create schema

Routes：
- GET /api/admin/faq — 分頁回傳 FAQs（含 category relation），支援 page/limit query params
- POST /api/admin/faq — 建立 FAQ，Zod 驗證，回 400 on invalid
- PATCH /api/admin/faq/[id] — 更新 FAQ，Zod partial 驗證
- DELETE /api/admin/faq/[id] — 刪除 FAQ

Pattern：與 AF-001-B 相同（auth → Zod → try/catch）。GET 支援 page (1-based, default 1) 與 limit (max 100, default 20) 參數，回傳 { generalFaqs, pagination: { page, limit, total, totalPages } }。
acceptance: GET /api/admin/faq returns paginated FAQs with category relation, supports page/limit params
POST /api/admin/faq creates FAQ with Zod validation, returns 400 on invalid input
PATCH /api/admin/faq/[id] updates FAQ, returns 404 if not found
All routes return 401 without auth, 403 for non-admin users
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
verification: npm run typecheck && curl with valid admin token: GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE FAQs
